'''Oric Traless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He served as the Council's chief combat advisor.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]],<ref name="Assault" /> Oric Traless was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] three centuries after the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Following the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the wake of the [[Great Galactic War]], the Jedi Order retreated from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and took up residence on their ancestral homeworld, [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. As a prolonged [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] took its toll on the galaxy, Traless was made a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and earned a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="TORFA" /> Traless wielded a green [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in combat. When the Sith Empire [[Assault on Tython|attacked]] Tython in [[3637 BBY]], Master Traless defended the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]], though he fell in combat against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invaders.<ref name="Assault" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oric Traless was first introduced in the [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', a tie-in to the then-upcoming [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. ''Fatal Alliance'' was largely ignored by ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} metaseries, as it was written early in the development process of ''The Old Republic''. However, Traless appeared in the Tactical Flashpoint: Assault on Tython that was released with Game Update 2.7: Invasion in [[April]] [[2014]], making him the first ''Fatal Alliance'' character aside from [[Satele Shan]] to reappear in continuity.
